description: This file defines the 'NoteEditScreen' React component for editing or creating notes in a React Native application. It manages note state, category selection, and interactions with the backend repository for notes and categories.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a note, either by creating a new one or updating an existing one, with validation and navigation upon success.

methods.name: addCategoryInline
methods.description: Creates a new category inline, updates the categories list, and sets the selected category.
